Which one to pick

Pick NanoScrape's Booking.com Scraper if

  • you track prices for many hotels or dates, where the per-hotel price dominates the bill;
  • you want the whole-stay price, nightly rate and cancellation policy in one row.

Pick Voyager if

  • you need its surroundings data (nearby places) or its room-offerings format;
  • you prefer the actor with the most users in the Store (about 1,100 in the last 30 days).
Finding it in the Store: search the Apify Store for booking scraper santamaria, or open it directly with the button above.

FAQ

Is the price per night or per stay?

On NanoScrape, price is the total for the whole stay and all searched rooms; price_per_night is the nightly rate.

Do I need a Booking.com account or API key?

No. Both actors read public search results. You need a free Apify account.

Are the prices the same for everyone?

No. Both actors list a Free-plan price and lower prices on paid Apify plans. The table shows Free-plan prices because that is what a new account pays.

Try it on one city first

Run 100 hotels for your dates on the Free plan; it costs about $0.30.
